"Ha-ha, that won't be necessary. At all," $heOrShe says quickly. "Thank you captain." 

"Let me welcome you once again, the Tri-Tachyon Corporation will be pleased to enjoy your business partnership during your stay, I'm sure."

"Keep it in the black, captain."

"Welcome once again, the Tri-Tachyon Corporation will be pleased to enjoy your business partnership during your stay."

"Keep it in the black, captain."
$HeOrShe quickly cuts the link before you can ask any more questions.

Your comms officer calls for your attention.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. There's an incoming comms request, marked urgent, from the portwatcher. They want to speak with you personally."

The $post looks like they've seen a ghost.

"Captain $playerLastName, by the grace of holy Ludd and all that is blessed, what unholy creation have you brought here? What have you done to your $shipOrFleet?"

The questions are rhetorical, judging by the chimes and pings from your tactical officer's console- targeting alerts from defense batteries.

"The curates technologia have already passed judgement on your... your unholy combination of human craft and demonic 'technology'," $heOrShe says.

"Go now from this place and never return! Take your technological abominations and be accursed in the eyes of God and the Church. You are henceforth an abomination to be destroyed on sight!"

$HeOrShe clasps $hisOrHer hands together, mumbling some prayer.

"The curates technologia have already passed judgement on your... your unholy combination of human craft and demonic 'technology'," $heOrShe says. "Your commission is revoked."

"Go now from this place and never return! Take your technological abominations and be accursed in the eyes of God and the Church. You are henceforth an abomination to be destroyed on sight!"

$HeOrShe clasps $hisOrHer hands together, mumbling some prayer.

"The curates technologia have already passed judgement on your... your unholy combination of human craft and demonic 'technology'," $heOrShe says. "You are excommunicated, declared outlaw and enemy of the Faith."

"Go now from this place and never return! Take your technological abominations and be accursed in the eyes of God and the Church. You are henceforth an abomination to be destroyed on sight!"

$HeOrShe clasps $hisOrHer hands together, mumbling some prayer.

"The curates technologia have already passed judgement on your... your unholy combination of human craft and demonic 'technology'," $heOrShe says. "Your commission is revoked. You are excommunicated, declared outlaw and enemy of the Faith."

"Go now from this place and never return! Take your technological abominations and be accursed in the eyes of God and the Church. You are henceforth an abomination to be destroyed on sight!"

$HeOrShe clasps $hisOrHer hands together, mumbling some prayer.

"The blessing of Ludd be upon-" The $post's eyes go suddenly wide at a red flash from a secondary display.

"By the holy pneuma," $heOrShe gasps.

"An abomination, a devil-$shipOrFleet from Hell itself is before us! We pray to Providence to pass this test which has been given unto our unworthy-"

The $post's words are for $hisOrHer crew, not you, and the link shudders into static. The last image you see are hands clasped in prayer.

"What by blessed Ludd's holy right glove have you done to your $shipOrFleet? Is that the cursed work of Moloch my eyes do perceive in your $shipOrFleet?"

$HeOrShe looks over $hisOrHer shoulder, "Summon the subcurate technologia! For immediate consultation!"

The $post turns back to you. "You have but a moment to explain what my sensors suggest, captain."

"Unique mod-" $HeOrShe sputters.

"It is devilry! You've joined human craft with abomination. It is an unholy thing!"  $HeOrShe makes some kind of hurry-up hand signal over $hisOrHer shoulder.

"You condemn your soul to the abyss. And you condemn yourself as mortal enemy to the Church and accursed in the eyes of God and all who hold faith." $HisOrHer expression is grim.

The $post turns and exchanges a few words with someone you can't see.

"Methinks there is not, $playerSirOrMadam, and you merely dissemble with a devil's tongue to gain advantage." $HeOrShe makes some kind of hurry-up hand signal over $hisOrHer shoulder.

"Judgement shall be pronounced ere long upon what my heart fears."

The $post turns and exchanges a few words with someone you can't see.

"Overt devilry. You've combined human craft with abomination." $HeOrShe makes some kind of hurry-up hand signal over $hisOrHer shoulder.

"By this unholy 'technology' you condemn your soul to the abyss. And you condemn yourself as mortal enemy to the Church, accursed in the eyes of God and all who hold faith!"

The $post turns and exchanges a few words with someone you can't see.

"You're certain?" $heOrShe asks. $HisOrHer face has gone pale, as if $heOrShe has been informed that $heOrShe has been condemned.

The briefest flash of emotions: pain, fear, outrage, sadness, acceptance. The eyes that turn back to the comm-link are that of an enemy across battle-lines.
"You are no longer," $heOrShe says.
"I abjure your heresy ," $heOrShe says.
"Corruptor, mammonite!" $heOrShe spits.

"There is no negotiation with evil, no compromise." The $post's words are for $hisOrHer crew, not you.

The link shudders into static, the last image is of hands clasped in a brief prayer.

Your comms officer calls for your attention.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. There's an incoming comms request, marked urgent, from the station commander. They want to speak with you personally."

The link flickers open and the conversation begins poorly.

"Befouler, defiler, sinful spite-God! Demoniac!"

The look of rage and religious mania pulls the $post's face into a devilish mask as $heOrShe shouts.

"What work-of-Moloch $shipOrFleet appears in our skies? What unholy combination of human craft and... and abomination? You are to be destroyed on sight, accursed by God and all who are faithful!"

$HeOrShe desperately clasps $hisOrHer hands together and prays. "Blessed Ludd, give me strength when the evil one appears..."

Targeting alerts chime from your tactical officer's console.

"Servant of Moloch! Redemption is not- is not..."

The Pather's eyes go wide at a red flash from a secondary display.

"By Ludd's hells, it is..." $HeOrShe returns to stare, horrified, through the comm-link. $HisOrHer face is full of terror... and hatred.
OR
"Submit and repent! Your use of sinful technologies may- may..."

The Pather's eyes go wide at a red flash from a secondary display.

"By the blessed stars is that..." $HisOrHer eyes return to the comm-link, fixed with horror... and hatred.

"May the Path be r-" The $post's eyes go suddenly wide at a red flash from a secondary display.

"Blessed Ludd!" $heOrShe gasps.

They return to the comm-link, fixed with fear... and hatred.

"Befouler, defiler, sinful spite-God! Demoniac!" The look of rage and religious mania pulls the $post's face into a devilish mask as $heOrShe shouts.

"What work-of-Moloch $shipOrFleet is this? What unholy combination of human craft and abomination? You are to be destroyed on sight, accursed by God and all who follow the Path of our faith!"

Targeting alerts chime from your tactical officer's console.
OR
"You accursed meddler, servant of Moloch! What unnatural work have you wrought in the shadow so far from the Path?"

Targeting alerts chime from your tactical officer's console.

"I name you abomination, adversary, god-spite! It is my holy duty to destroy your infernal $shipOrFleet," $heOrShe shouts, flecks of spittle flashing in the holo. "-And you as well before you slither back into the abyss whence you spawned!"

"Before me I saw evil incarnate, and I stood strong..." The $Post's words are for $hisOrHer crew, not you.

The link shudders into static, the last image is of hands clasped in a brief prayer.

"Before me I saw evil incarnate, and-"

The Pather's words are lost in static as you hit the comms-cutoff.

Thanks to your efforts, the food shortage is now over before it had a chance to cause much chaos. $marketName's long-term stability is unaffected by the shortage.
Thanks to your efforts, the food shortage is now over. Its impact on $marketName's stability is reduced.

Thanks to your illicit efforts, the food shortage is now over. Since much of the food you've delivered went through channels of questionable legality, there's not much hope - or, indeed, desire - for official recognition.
Thanks in part to your efforts, the recent food shortage is over. Your standing with $theMarketFaction should improve slightly.
Tapping into the comm network for local news, you learn that there was a recent food shortage. Though the shortage is now over, the local situation is still somewhat destabilized.
Tapping into the comm network for local news, you learn that there was a recent and protracted food shortage. Though the shortage is now over, the local situation is still highly destabilized.
You try to establish a comm link, but get only static.
$PersonRank $personName looks aggravated. "If you want to talk, identify yourself first."
$PersonRank $personName looks concerned. "If you want to talk, identify yourself first."
You issue an order to activate the transponder and re-open the comm link.
"Acknowledging receipt of AIS code. Good to see you, $playerName."
"Hostile $shipOrFleet, be advised: we've already dispatched a distress call to a nearby patrol, and it should arrive shortly."

The enemy $personRank looks grim but defiant. "We will fight you to the last," $heOrShe says.
OR
"Damn, we're in a tight spot." $PersonRank $personName suddenly notices the line is open and shuts it off.
It appears the enemy $personRank doesn't seem to feel the need to talk to you, as your comm requests go unanswered.
"You have been scanned and identified. It's probably best for both our peace of mind if you keep your distance."

"You have been scanned and," $heOrShe blinks at $hisOrHer screen, then says almost - but not quite - under $hisOrHer breath, "$playerName. The butcher." 

$HeOrShe straightens $hisOrHer back, "It'd be best if you kept your distance. We, we are armed."
OR
As the comms resolve, $rank $personLastName looks at you with recognition and alarm.

"It's... you. The things you've done, I can't believe-" $heOrShe clears $hisOrHer throat uncomfortably, "What is it you want?"
"Ah, Captain $playerName." $HeOrShe looks uncomfortable. "Your reputation... precedes you. Let us conclude our business quickly then go our own ways."

"Acknowledging receipt of your codes, moving to a secure channel." A flicker of a phoenix icon and static, then: "Yes? All is well I trust? Glad to hear it, citizen. Over and out."
OR
"Your $shipOrFleet has been scanned and identified, everything is in order. Burn bright, citizen."
OR
"Scanned and identified. You're flying pretty, citizen. Clean jumps and high burn." $PersonRank $personName signs off with a flash of the gold phoenix.
